rows.clause: works contracts incl. government civil works, from 22 Sep 2025
rows.source: CBIC rate notification 22 Sep 2025 (researched in-repo: theka/rules.py v0.117, 22 Oct 2026)

rows.clause: CGST Sec 51 - government / local authority / notified bodies deduct 2% of taxable value (excl. GST) when the contract exceeds Rs 2.5 lakh
rows.source: CGST Act s.51 (researched in-repo: theka/rules.py v0.117)

rows.clause: TDS on contract payments 1% (individual / HUF) or 2% (others) above Rs 30,000 per payment or Rs 1 lakh a year; 20% without PAN
rows.source: Income-tax Act 2025 Sec 393(1) (old 194C) (researched in-repo: theka/rules.py v0.117)

rows.clause: 1% of the cost of construction (land excluded), deducted from bills by government / PSUs or paid in advance on self-assessment
rows.source: Code on Social Security 2020, in force 21 Nov 2025 (researched in-repo: theka/rules.py v0.117)

rows.clause: 70% of the receipts for a project into a designated account, withdrawable against certified progress
rows.source: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act 2016, s.4(2)(l)(D); MahaRERA the state authority

rows.clause: the designated-account statements audited by a chartered accountant within six months after the end of every financial year, and published
rows.source: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act 2016, s.4(2)(l)(D) proviso; MahaRERA the state authority

rows.clause: carpet-area shortfall beyond 3% obliges the promoter to refund with interest (the tolerance the carpet checker flags against)
rows.source: MahaRERA instructions on carpet-area variation (re-check the circular on primary text before reliance)
